## What Teja does

Teja K G solves manufacturing and product-engineering problems by combining physical engineering with automation and software. His work spans manufacturing productivity, fixture development, hardware test automation, simulation, supplier transitions, verification and validation, electronics, firmware, and cross-functional technical problem solving.

## Measurable engineering impact

- Reduced manufacturing cycle time by 90% using an IMU sensor-based fixture approach while generating more than $1M in annual savings.
- Reduced hardware test cycles by 50% with Python-based test automation.
- Reduced assembly trial-and-error time by 30% using DELMIA simulation.
- Reduced wet-deposition tool cycle time by 5% using Value Stream Mapping and ZBRA matrix analysis.
- Developed an AI/LLM-based Test Procedure Instruction automation concept with an estimated $120k/year saving opportunity.

## Experience

### GE HealthCare

Engineering / Manufacturing Engineering. Work includes medical imaging manufacturing engineering, supplier transitions, localization, verification and validation, prototype assembly, engineering documentation, risk-retirement testing, and customer-critical manufacturing problem solving for mobile radiography and mammography systems.

### Lam Research

Manufacturing Engineer. Work included semiconductor equipment manufacturing productivity, wet-deposition process improvement, IMU-based fixtures, hardware validation automation, DELMIA assembly simulation, and manufacturing project coordination.

### Early-stage engineering startup

Product / Electronics Engineering. Hands-on work across electronics, PCB design, firmware development, and early-stage product engineering.
